items.text: Hanyuma y’ivyo, Yesu arajabuka aja ku ruhande rwo hakurya y’ikiyaga c’i Galilaya (ari co kiyaga c’i Tiberiya).
Abantu isinzi baramukurikira kuko bari babonye ibitangaza yari yakoze mu gukiza abagwaye.
Nuko Yesu aduga ku musozi yicarana n’abigishwa biwe.
Ico gihe Umusi mukuru wa Pasika w’Abayuda wari wegereje.
Yesu abonye abantu benshi baje bamutumbereye, abarira Filipo ati:
Yabajije ico kibazo nk’uwumugeza, kuko we yari azi ico agiye gukora.
Filipo aramwishura ati: “Naho tworonka idenariyo amajana abiri
Yari impembo y’umukozi mu mezi 8.
, ntitwokuramwo ivyokurya bikwiye n’umutamiro w’umwumwe.”
Umwe mu bigishwa biwe yitwa Andereya, yavukana na Simoni Petero, abwira Yesu ati:
“Hano hariho umuhungu afise imikate y’ingano itanu n’ifi zibiri. Ariko vyomara iki ku bantu bangana uku?”
Yesu aravuga ati:
Aho hantu hari ubwatsi bwinshi. Nuko abo bantu baricara (abagabo bonyene bashika nk’ibihumbi bitanu).
Yesu afata ya mikate, ayishimira Imana, ayiha abari bicaye ngaho. Na za fi azigenza uko. Abantu bararya nk’uko babishaka.
Bamaze guhaga bose, Yesu abwira abigishwa biwe ati:
Nuko begeranya utumanyagu twa ya mikate itanu y’ingano abantu bariye, buzuza ibiseke cumi na bibiri.
Abantu babonye igitangaza Yesu akoze baravuga bati: “Ni ivy’ukuri uwu ni wa muvugishwa twari twiteze kw’isi.”
Yesu amenye ko bagira baze ngo bamwimike ku nguvu nk’umwami, aca asubira ku musozi ari wenyene.
Bugorovye, abigishwa ba Yesu bamanuka ku kiyaga,
burira ubwato kugira ngo bajabuke baje i Kaperinawumu. Aho rero hari hamaze kuza umuzimagiza kandi Yesu ntiyari bwabashikire.
Ico gihe, umuyaga wariko urahuhuta cane bituma haba imipfunda myinshi mu kiyaga.
Bamaze gusoza nka sitadiyo mirongo ibiri na zitanu canke mirongo itatu
Ni nk’ibilometero 5 canke 6.
, babona Yesu agendagenda ku mazi yegera ubwato barimwo, maze bagira ubwoba.
Yesu arababwira ati:
Nuko bashaka kumwuriza mu bwato, ariko buba burashitse ku nkengera aho bari bagiye.
Ku musi ukurikira, hariho abantu benshi bari basigaye hakurya y’ikiyaga, maze bibuka ko hariho ubwato bumwe bwonyene abigishwa bagiyemwo, kandi ko Yesu atinjiranye n’abigishwa biwe muri bwo.
Ico gihe ubundi bwato bwinshi buvuye i Tiberiya, bwariko buraza bushika hamwe Umwami Yesu yahezagirira imikate abantu bakayifungura.
Maze abantu babonye ko Yesu n’abigishwa biwe atari ho bari, baca binjira muri ubwo bwato baja i Kaperinawumu kumuronderayo.
Bamusanze aho yari hakurya y’ikiyaga, baramubaza bati: “Mwigisha, washitse hano ryari?”
Yesu arabishura ati:
Baramubaza bati: “Natwe turashaka gukora ibikorwa vy’Imana. None tubigenze gute?”
Yesu arabishura ati:
Baramubwira bati: “Mbega nta gitangaza wokora kugira ngo tukibone hanyuma twizere? Ni ikihe wokora?
Ba sogokuruza bacu baririye manu mu bugaragwa, kuko Ivyanditswe Vyera bivuga biti: ‘Mose yabahaye imikate ivuye mw’ijuru ngo bayirye.’
Kuvayo 16:4; Nehemiya 9:15; Zaburi 78:24,25
Yesu arababwira ati:
Baramubwira bati: “Nyakwubahwa, turagusavye wame uduha uwo mukate imisi yose.”
Yesu arabishura ati:
Maze Abayuda batangura kumwidogera kuko avuze ati:
Baravuga bati: “Mbega uwu si Yesu mwene Yosefu? Se na nyina ntitubazi? None ni gute avuga ngo:
Yesu arabishura ati:
Yesaya 54:13
Maze Abayuda batangura guharira hagati yabo bashavuye bati: “Ni gute uwu mugabo yoduha umubiri wiwe ngo tuwurye?”
Yesu arababwira ati:
Yesu yavuze ivyo ariko arigishiriza mw’isinagogi i Kaperinawumu.
Benshi bo mu bigishwa biwe bavyumvise baravuga bati: “Izi nyigisho ziragumye. Ni nde yozemera?”
Yesu amenye ko abigishwa biwe bariko baridoga, arababaza ati:
Kuko kuva mu ntago, Yesu yari azi abatizera n’uwuzomugurisha.
Yongerako ati:
Kuva ico gihe benshi mu bigishwa biwe baca baragenda ntibasubira kumukurikira.
Yesu ahindukirira bamwe cumi na babiri arababaza ati:
Simoni Petero aramwishura ati: “Mwami, twokuvako tugakurikira nde? Erega ni wewe ufise amajambo atanga ubugingo budashira!
Twebwe twarakwizeye turatahura ko uri Uwera w’Imana.”
Yesu aca arababwira ati:
(Aho yariko avuga Yuda, mwene Simoni Isikariyote. Kuko naho yari umwe muri bamwe cumi na babiri, ni we yari agiye kumugurisha.)
